summary: IIOT-OXYS, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding an amendment to a securities purchase agreement with GHS Investments, LLC. The amendment adds two additional closings for the sale of Series D Convertible Preferred Stock at $1,000 per share, with total authorized shares increased to 167. On June 16, 2026, the company issued 30 shares (27 purchased for $27,000 plus 3 incentive shares) in a third closing. The offering was conducted under Rule 506(b) of Regulation D to an accredited investor, with no general solicitation. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
